description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window_gmt.note: Signals generated only within this window. Engine will not fire outside it.

macro_kill_switches.note_vix_caution: VIX 20-25: only HIGH-confidence signals (5-6/6). VIX 25-30: add position sizing note.

earnings_blackout.note: Exclude ticker from analysis if earnings fall within this window in either direction.

confluence_thresholds.note: 5-6/6 = HIGH (act on it). 4/6 = MEDIUM (smaller size note). ≤3/6 = WAIT (no output).

risk.note: Stop = entry - (stop_atr_multiplier × ATR14). Target = entry + (target_atr_multiplier × ATR14). R:R must be ≥ min_rr or signal is downgraded to WAIT.

position_limits.note: Never issue more than max_concurrent_signals BUY signals in a single run. Trader sizes each position to risk no more than max_account_risk_per_trade_pct of account.

extreme_volatility_block.note: If BB width > 2x 30d avg AND ATR > 2x 90d avg, output WAIT regardless of confluence score.
